description: 3DBioFibR is a biomaterials manufacturing company, with a patented dry-spinning technology to produce highly consistent collagen fibers at commercial scales for tissue engineering and regenerative medicine. These fibers closely match the biomechanical and biochemical properties of natural collagen fibers, and can be produced at over 3600x the throughput of competing technologies such as electrospinning and wet spinning.

Dartmouth, Nova Scotia and Beverly Hills, California-based Arcturus is the global leader in authoring, editing and distributing volumetric videos. With tools to edit, compress and stream volumetric video at scale in today's spatial era, Arcturus is revolutionizing the immersive content experience, from viewing live sports in holographic form, experiencing photorealistic visual performances, engaging with interactive digital assistants to interacting online with products in 3D.

description: Bright Breaks is a technology-enabled workplace well-being platform designed to address the challenges of hybrid and remote work.

Carbide simplifies information security and privacy management for B2B software companies selling into large enterprises and highly regulated industries. Customers rely on the Securicy platform to provide structure, guidance, automation, and expertise to turn security from a risk to a competitive advantage, especially as their company grows.

Curv is a SaaS-enabled marketplace for healthcare services providers. The platform enables health providers to launch and operate their own digital private practice — to deliver digital services directly to clients.

description: Dash Social is a social media management platform that equips brands with intelligence and speed to stay ahead of the curve. Through its sophisticated cross-channel insights and workflow tools, Dash Social enables brands to create content that entertains, engages and drives consistent business results.

Musical AI is how musicians, songwriters, and rights holders control and monetize the use of their works by artificial intelligence models, while giving AI companies easy, legal access to high-quality music. Rights holders safely license their catalogs for training through the platform—with clear usage terms, patent-pending attribution for fair compensation, and secure infrastructure—while AI companies gain a streamlined, compliant solution for training and deploying models without legal headaches.

PayTic offers a new solution that streamlines back-office operations and risk control of digital payments. PayTic offers an all-in-one solution that centralizes the program management for banks, FinTechs and credit unions so they don't need to navigate siloed technologies and systems to reconcile payments, detect frauds, manage disputes and fill in regulatory reports.

ProcedureFlow, a Software as a Service (SaaS) company, redefines the delivery of training and customer experience learning in the workplace. The software delivers complex processes and learning materials through an intuitive flow system – reducing training time, increasing customer experience scores, and ensuring best practices are maintained across its clients’ organizations.

Spring Loaded is developing unique, proprietary knee bracing technologies in order to enhance the power output of the quadriceps muscles. The benefits of this technology include reduced fatigue and heightened endurance for athletes, and increased mobility, reduced joint compression and reduced pain for individuals with knee injuries or osteoarthritis. Spring Loaded Technology is based in Halifax, Nova Scotia.

Sydney, Nova Scotia-based Talem Health Analytics is transforming insurance claims management by placing in-depth, scientific injury analysis at the insurers' fingertips from the very start of a claim. This enables the insurer to better understand injury likelihood, suitable treatment protocols and recovery timeline to make data-driven claims management decisions.
Tenera Care is a management platform for Long Term Care facilities that improves resident health and safety while enhancing operational efficiency and employee satisfaction.

Saint John, New Brunswick-based TrojAI is a cybersecurity firm dedicated to building cybersecurity solutions to enhance and protect AI innovations from both naturally occurring and adversarial "data poisoning" and "model evasion" attacks which can adversely influence model behaviors.

Trophi.ai is revolutionizing coaching in sports by leveraging the latest in data and AI, making coaching affordable and accessible to every child, hobbyist, and athlete. They are initially focused on gaming and eSports and will then take their technology to the next level in the real world.
